title: Old and New Buildings: *míg … addig*, *ezzel éles ellentétben*
grammar: Contrast in a debate about old and new buildings
goal: I can set two views against each other (*míg … addig*, *ezzel éles ellentétben*, *szembeállítva*).
I can name the words of the preservation debate (*műemlékvédelem*, *stílustörés*, *funkcionalizmus*).
I can write a sentence that contrasts old and new buildings.
